_readme: THE ONE PLACE where the kit's operating thresholds live. statusline.sh, the hooks and
/ahora read this file; none of them may carry the number itself. A missing or unreadable
file is NOT a licence to fall back to a hardcoded default: the bar prints an amber
'umbrales' warning and stops colouring and hinting, because a threshold you cannot read
is not the same thing as a threshold that is not crossed.
id        stable name; code looks thresholds up BY ID, never by position
priority  lower fires first. The bar shows ONE hint: the lowest priority that matches
hint      true = it can produce a hint; false = it is only a band (colour, gate, hook)
condition {metric, op, value} — metric is measured by the caller, op is >= > <= <
A metric that could not be measured is -1 and never matches (unknown != zero)
gate      id of another threshold whose condition must ALSO hold
param     extra number the threshold needs; meaning documented per threshold
actions   default / fresh (HANDOFF up to date) / nodata (the detail is missing)
placeholders: {n} the metric's current value, {h} hours, {causes} cache causes
source    where the number came from. No source = it is invented and must be deleted
confirmed: 2026-09-18 — owner confirmed every value below unchanged from statusline.sh

actions.default: límite 5h al {n}% → para o baja a sonnet
